name: B10-0421/2025 (The Left) – United response to recent Russian violations of the EU Member States’ airspace and critical infrastructure
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on a united response to recent Russian violations of the EU Member States’ airspace and critical infrastructure
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for a calm, united response to recent Russian violations of European airspace. It condemns any deliberate intrusion but warns that rushed or excessive reactions could escalate tensions. It asks the European Commission and the High Representative to publish a full public report on all alleged airspace incidents since 2022, with the evidence and the uncertainties. It also calls for stronger defences against drones and for diplomacy, arms control and open communication channels with Russia.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. This is the Parliament's opinion and set of requests, not a new law.
- **Who it affects:** European Union governments, the Commission, the High Representative and NATO.
- **What happens next:** The text goes to the Council, the Commission, member states, NATO, the OSCE and the United Nations.
